pre_exposure: The 2026 paper's table 3 values on four isotherms were exposed by an indexed source query before this freeze. All 2026 acoustics are archival calibration for the direct-sound comparator only. No Ahmadi table 12 acoustic cell or table 13 fitted coefficient has been inspected. Numerical contents of Ahmadi table 10 were used only for pre-outcome independent densimeter checking. The 2026 paper compares its measurements against Ahmadi, so this is cross-instrument retrospective data with locally prospective predictions, not historical forecasting.

target.output: directly measured glycerol sound velocity in m/s, first velocity column after T in K, pressure in MPa, and phase Liquid; exclude fitted velocity, deviation and derived properties
target.acoustics: through-transmission, nominal 2–2.25 MHz transducers; equilibrium thermodynamic prediction assumes negligible dispersion for the relevant liquid state and instrument bandwidth. The source does not measure a static elastic modulus. Pressure as tabulated; no gauge conversion.
target.specimen: Sigma-Aldrich glycerol, reported supplier >=0.995 mole fraction, water <=0.20% by weight. No common specimen/lot or matched water content between publications is assumed.

source.density: 18 direct DMA HPM observations in the six complete nominal isotherms through 373.15 K below the upper limit of the calorimeter sweep, at .1,10,20 MPa, from Table 6. The three points at nominal 393.16K fall above the calorimeter maximum390.48K. Lower thermal-support bound298.18K uses the full nominal low-temperature triplet; individual measurement input temperature is used in fitting.
source.calorimetry: 55 observations from Table 7 at 0.1MPa in kJ/kg/K, converted to J/kg/K. No direct high-pressure calorimetry used.
source.author_equations: Only Table4 columns eq5/6,14/15,16, marked EXP. Printed ambient cp control retained despite its documented calibration mismatch. No equation31/32 or quantities integrated from acoustic outcomes enter the thermal forecasts. The authentic Eq6 direct-acoustic model is a separate higher-information comparator. Its source includes frequencies/temperatures different from the target and the 2026 article compared with historical literature.
source.duplicate_records: Input table6 indexed excerpt has repeated rows across its visual columns; exact matching T,p,rho rows deduplicated. The chosen six isotherms each have exactly three distinct pressures.
source.older_density: The full 2016 ThermoML file was originally authenticated and 24+36 rows were inventoried; the separate numeric receiver received HTTP403. No 2016 numerical observations enter fitting or claims.

models: Specific volume polynomial in centered T and p, degrees (3,0),(2,1),(1,2) with all lower terms; ambient cp cubic. Maxwell-consistent pressure increment cp(T,p)-cp0(T)=-T integral v_TT dp. Sound uses -v^2/(v_p+T v_T²/cp) with derivatives per Pa and per K. Reduced arm removes quadratic pressure and retains a linear-in-temperature pressure slope. Literal author density Tait uses its exact pressure derivative, symmetric T step 0.02K and analytic pressure integral; repeat at .04K and require <.01m/s for every state. No viscosity-dependent dispersion or water composition corrections.
qualification: Treat individual published expanded density margins as deterministic feasibility constraints, without assigning joint coverage. Preserve coherent pressure tilt witness and its conditioning by in-domain independent direct VTD observations; neither branch offers acoustic point identification within instrument uncertainty. Held evaluation tests point prediction only. No recalibration on this historical table.

cohorts.all: all 50 records in physical table order
cohorts.primary: intersection with direct sound calibration, 340 <= T_K <=373.15 and .1 <= p_MPa <=20. Exactly eight rows spanning nominal 348 and 373 K. Fixed from ranges only.
cohorts.other: retain every pressure/temperature extrapolation and any invalid model state without clipping, replacement or renormalization. An invalid forecast makes a cohort role unranked; still count it.

metric: Within each cohort and role report n, MAE in m/s, RMSE in m/s, mean absolute percent 100*abs(predicted-observed)/observed, maximum abs residual and its raw row for every role. For the candidate worst row report every comparator outcome at that same state. Report primary per nominal isotherm and all-field residuals. Isotherms are not replicate specimens; no iid intervals.
gate: On the eight primary cells, Gibbs must strictly improve both RMSE and mean absolute percent error against all six comparators, with lower RMSE at each of two primary isotherms against the strongest other role on that isotherm. Report same-information and acoustic-informed comparisons separately even if the joint gate fails. Invalid cells prevent a pass. Full50 results remain descriptive with extrapolations. Fit/speed/margin parameters are closed before outcome access.
